listing.name: SweetFleet 0.5.7 - fleet sorting, logistics analysis, officer fit
listing.summary: SweetFleet is a utility QoL mod: multi-criteria fleet sorting with editable global presets, a logistics/affordability screen (overreach flags + Efficiency Overhaul hints), officer-fit suggestions (including your commander), and SF Sort / SF Settings on the Fleet tab. Hotkeys F8 (sort) / F7 (analyze). Requires LazyLib; Console Commands optional. Developed with heavy use of Cursor Auto mode (AI coding agents) — I directed design and tested in-game; report bugs with starsector.log.
listing.aiSummary: Adds multi-criteria fleet sorting, logistics analysis, and officer fit suggestions to streamline fleet management.

description:
SweetFleet

is a utility mod that makes fleet management less of a chore: multi-criteria sorting with editable presets, a logistics/affordability screen, officer-to-ship fit suggestions, and Fleet-tab buttons so you can reach it without leaving the screen.

Disclaimer:

This mod was developed with heavy use of

Cursor

Auto mode (AI coding agents). I directed the design and tested in-game; the implementation was largely produced by those models. Treat it accordingly - please report bugs with a starsector.log if something breaks.

Compatible with:

Starsector 0.98a (built against 0.98a-RC8)

Category:

Utility / QoL

Save-safe:

Yes - add or remove mid-campaign

Download:

SweetFleet-0.5.7.zip

Source / releases:

github.com/daerogami/sweet-fleet

Requirements

LazyLib (required)
Console Commands (optional) - for the sweetfleetsort command

Screenshots

Fleet tab %u2014 SF Sort / SF Settings in the controls column

Sort presets editor (SF Settings)

Sort confirmation on the campaign map

Logistics / affordability analysis

Officer fit %u2014 suggested reassignment

Officer fit %u2014 already optimal

Features

Multi-criteria sorting - order by a chain of properties (e.g. hull size, then value), not one column
Editable sort presets - create, rename, and reorder presets in SF Settings; selecting a preset makes it active for SF Sort and the hotkey. Presets are global (outside saves / the mod folder) and survive updates
Logistics & affordability analysis - per-ship supply/fuel/value, monthly report income, trailing income history, overreach flags, Efficiency Overhaul hints
Officer-fit suggestions - heuristic skill<-->hull matching, including the commander, with optional apply
Fleet-tab buttons - SF Sort and SF Settings in the fleet controls column; hotkeys still work if you disable the overlay

Usage

F8 - sort with the active preset
F7 - analysis dialog (campaign map; not from an open Core UI tab)
Console: sweetfleetsort, sweetfleetsort analyze, sweetfleetsort settings, sweetfleetsort help

Sort properties: hull size, value, supplies/month, fuel/LY, deployment points, combat readiness, hull integrity, D-mod count, officer assigned, mothballed, ship name.

Config: data/config/sweetfleet/config.json

Presets: Starsector/saves/common/sweetfleet-presets.data

Version Checker / TriOS update tracking is supported.

Changelog (0.5.7)

Added civilian hull sorting parameterChanged the default sort preset to a more thorough chain

Earlier 0.5.x highlights

Changelog (0.5.6)

Fixed a crash when opening officer-fit suggestionsFixed a crash in cost analysis when a ship was flagged for hull valueFixed SF Sort / SF Settings hover flickerPreset names with a percent sign are cleaned to avoid display errors

Changelog (before 0.5.6)

0.5.5 - Fixed Fleet-tab crash when dragging a ship with the SweetFleet buttons shown0.5.4 - Selecting a preset makes it active immediately; commander included in officer fit0.5.3 - More sort keys; one row per property with both directions0.5.0 - Global editable presets and in-game editor0.4.0 - Initial sort / analysis / officer fit / Fleet-tab buttons

[close]

Feedback and bug reports welcome. Please include starsector.log for crashes.
